name: Aerial Formation — "any number of target creatures" is targeted, not every creature
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py while fixing the 'They gain' cluster. 'Any number of target creatures each get +1/+1 and gain flying until end of turn.' fell through extractTargetInfo and became a global effect on every creature. It is now a multi-target effect (6 slots). About 25 cards shared the wording (Ajani's Presence, Colossal Heroics, Launch the Fleet, Kamahl's Will, …).
